decisions.reason: The bio-based bitumen binder remains a flagship that signals the firm's circular, low-emission direction, and growth-driven slack lets management carry it a while longer, though its distance from the core plant business and uncertain uptake keep the withdrawal risk substantial.

The infectious waste decontamination plant sits close to the core modular plant business, is backed by the ERMAFA partnership and featured on the home page, so with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations it is likely to stay.
